mapper.insert: insert into question (asker_id, author_id, title, content, status, time) values (#{askerId}, #{authorId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{status}, #{time})
mapper.select: select q.*, u.name as authorName from question q left join user u on q.author_id = u.id where q.asker_id = #{askerId} order by q.id desc
select q.*, u.name as askerName, u.avatar as askerAvatar from question q left join user u on q.asker_id = u.id where q.author_id = #{authorId} order by q.id desc
